summary: RELX PLC, a UK foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K containing routine disclosures of ordinary share buybacks executed through ABN AMRO Bank N.V. on the London Stock Exchange. The filings detail weekly repurchases in July 2026, with aggregate volumes and price ranges (e.g., 852,599 shares at average 2333.8p in the first week). Shares bought are held in treasury, reducing issued share capital and returning capital to shareholders. The buyback runs under a pre-existing program; no tender offer, premium, or board recommendation is stated. What to watch: continued pace of repurchases and impact on EPS.
